summary: Frontend E2E tested DriverVehiclePicker on /driver for LOGITRAK. All 7 scenarios PASS: ALL/SELECTED/SINGLE modes, selection, claim toast, localStorage persistence, revocation notice + purge, SINGLE lock (ATTRIBUÉ badge + lock icon + disabled options), and backend 403 fail-closed on out-of-scope claim. Cleanup executed: Jean Dupont restored to mode=ALL (verified via GET vehicle-access), UI re-lists 18 vehicles.

test_results.T1_ALL_no_default_no_autoselect: PASS — badge 'Tous les véhicules', 18 options, no selected badge, claim disabled
test_results.T2_select_and_claim: PASS — 'SÉLECTIONNÉ' badge appears, claim enabled, toast 'Session démarrée'
test_results.T3_localStorage_persistence: PASS — key 'logitrak.driver.vehicle.<userId>' persists VID1; after reload VID1 aria-pressed='true'
test_results.T4_SELECTED_mode_2_vehicles: PASS — only VID2 and VID3 visible; default VID2 auto-selected
test_results.T5_revocation_on_refresh: PASS — notice testid visible with correct message; localStorage no longer contains revoked VID1 (replaced by VID2=default)
test_results.T6_SINGLE_mode_locked: PASS — mode='Véhicule attribué' with lock icon, 1 option, badge='ATTRIBUÉ', option disabled (locked), claim btn active
test_results.T7_backend_403_out_of_scope: PASS — POST /api/livre/driver/claim → 403 detail='Véhicule non autorisé pour ce chauffeur'
test_results.CLEANUP_restore_ALL: PASS — mode=ALL, vehicle_ids=[], default=None; UI shows 18 vehicles

critical_code_review_comments: DriverVehiclePicker/driverVehicleSelection: logic is clean, fail-closed on API error, and priority order (current > localStorage > default > unique) is correctly implemented.

Minor: on SELECTED refresh, when both a notice is shown AND default is auto-selected + localStorage rewritten, the spec suggested 'notice OU default+purge'. Current implementation does BOTH (which is a superset — arguably better UX). Not a bug.
seed_data_creation: None. Only PUT vehicle-access mutations, fully reverted to mode=ALL at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DriverVehiclePicker on /driver route (NOT /livre/*) uses GET /api/livre/driver/vehicles. Note: driver login defaults to /livre/dashboard; must explicitly goto /driver. localStorage key format: 'logitrak.driver.vehicle.<user.id>'. Vehicle-access admin schema: {mode: ALL|SELECTED|SINGLE, vehicle_ids:[uuid], default_vehicle_id:uuid|null}.
